retrievalProfile.description: A stark, high-contrast monochrome portrait cutout with jagged edges placed against a flat, textured pastel background with typewriter-style metadata.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, high-contrast black and white portrait of a male figure, appearing as a physical cutout with sharp, slightly irregular edges. The face features deep shadows and bright highlights, emphasizing skin texture and facial structure. The background is a solid, slightly grainy pastel pink. Small, monospaced text is positioned at the bottom center.
coreVisualRelationships: Stark monochrome subject against a vibrant pastel field
Rough, hand-cut silhouette edges against a clean background
Deep black shadows in the portrait mirroring the dark clothing base
Tiny, functional typography balancing a large, expressive central head
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white processing on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large, centered portrait occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes and mouth of the high-contrast portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the intense gaze of the portrait, move down the high-contrast facial features to the dark base, and settle on the small text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample, uniform pastel pink space surrounding the head and shoulders.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation background vs. low value, high contrast subject.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to monochrome subject and a single pastel hue background.

letterConstructionRules: Small scale relative to the canvas
graphicDevices: Subtle halftone screen on the portrait

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classic typewriter aesthetic with clean legibility.
Modern monospaced look with excellent geometric balance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a person with intense lighting, cut out with jagged, irregular edges like a physical collage, and place it centered on a textured pastel pink background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of small, centered, uppercase monospaced text at the very bottom of the frame in black.

verificationChecks: Are the cutout edges sharp and slightly irregular?
Is the background a flat pastel pink with subtle grain?
Is the text small, monospaced, and centered at the bottom?

mustRedesign: Avoid smooth, feathered edges on the portrait cutout
Do not use vibrant or neon background colors
Ensure the text is not large or decorative

mustAchieve: Stark tonal separation in the portrait

postGenerationChecks: Verify the 'cut-and-paste' aesthetic of the silhouette
Ensure the pink background has a matte, grainy finish
Confirm text is monospaced and tiny
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W cutout + Pastel textured field + Bottom-aligned monospaced metadata.
